speaker: Schedar
style: Say evenly and clearly, like a calm, friendly college professor running a lab.
lines: Welcome to Illusion Lab. Here, you are the subject. Pick a station card, do the task first, then compare your results with the research.
Make the bottom shaft look as long as the top one. Use Longer and Shorter to adjust it.
Done. Your settings are on the chart beside a perfect match.
Make the swatch match square A. Use Lighter and Darker to adjust it.
Now match square B. Use Lighter and Darker to adjust it.
One bar, one gray. A and B were the same all along. Try Hide the scene, then open Why.
Tap a stage to follow the signal. Then tap Edge or Middle to predict where neighboring outputs will differ most.
Slide Neighbor inhibition all the way right. Then choose each other Pattern to compare the output.
A bright band and a dark band at the edge. The light did not change there. The cells did that.
Press Start to begin the pictures. You can choose Flip by hand to step through them yourself.
Right spot. Tap the kind of change.
Last scene, with no gray gap. Watch how fast you find this one.
Read the three letters. Then tap the next number, counting back by threes, until the box asks for the letters. Press Start.
Type the three characters in their original order, then press Submit.
Press Next trial. Keep the next three characters in mind while counting backward by threes.
Words will show one at a time. Just read them. Then type every one you remember. Press Start.
For each word, tap Seen or New. After Seen, tap Picture it or Just know.
Type a word and press Enter to add it. Press Done when finished.
Press Start next list. Read each word, then use Seen or New in the test.
Tap Picture it if you can picture the word on screen, or Just know if it feels familiar.
Your own memory result is at the top. Read down to see why it matters in court.
Your results stay on this device. Scroll across the table, or tap Go to station to run one again.
Pick a station card to start. Line Lengths is a good first one.
When the shafts look equal, press Lock it in.
Keep adjusting with Longer or Shorter until the shafts look equal.
Keep adjusting the swatch with Lighter or Darker.
When the swatch looks equal, press Lock it in.
Move Neighbor inhibition. Visit every stage and test all patterns at full inhibition, then press Compare.
Slide Neighbor inhibition all the way right to test this pattern.
Tap each stage without a check mark to follow the whole pathway.
Choose an untested Pattern: Step edge, Patch on dark, or Patch on light. Keep the slider all the way right.
All three patterns are tested. Press Compare to review the edge and interior signals.
Press Spotted it first, then tap.
Loading pictures. All scene pairs load before Start becomes available.
Tap where the change is. With a keyboard, use the scene crosshair and Enter.
Press Next scene to continue.
Press Flip to compare the pictures. When you see the change, press Spotted it.
Watch for a change. Press Spotted it, then tap the spot.
Tap the change. Or move the scene crosshair with arrow keys, then press Enter.
See both pictures first. Press Flip, then Spotted it.
See both pictures first, then press Spotted it.
That location or kind did not match. Press Flip to watch again, then Spotted it.
That location or kind did not match. Watch again, then press Spotted it.
Change recorded. Press Next scene.
Location recorded; the kind needed correction. Compare the frames, then press Next scene.
Not found. Compare the two frames, then press Next scene.
Press Start: No gap. Watch how fast you find this one.
Press Start for the next scene.
Keep it in your head. Counting starts next.
Tap the number that is three less. Keep counting until recall opens.
Read each word. The list will finish on its own.
Compare your settings with the reference. Open Why to see what this experiment can explain.
Press Bridge to join A and B with one gray. Try Hide the scene, then open Why.
Read the explanation. Press Compare to return to your own observations, or Notebook to see your complete record.
Type the three letters, then press Submit. An empty answer is a result too.
Type the three digits, then press Submit. An empty answer is a result too.
Bridge hidden. Press Bridge to join A and B, or try Hide the scene.
